# Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Thomas N. Kipf, Max Welling  
**Year:** 2017  
**Journal:** ICLR  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1609.02907](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1609.02907)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.02907](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.02907)

**Keywords:** gcn, graph convolutional network

## Abstract

We present a scalable approach for semi-supervised learning on graph-structured data based on an efficient variant of convolutional neural networks.
